# CI-only pins for the dev dependencies in requirements-dev.txt and everything
# they pull in. Used as `pip install -r requirements-dev.txt -c .github/ci-constraints.txt`
# by the CI and release workflows, so a new release of a dev dependency cannot
# change a run on its own. requirements-dev.txt stays unpinned: it is what
# contributors and the create-tess template install.
#
# A constraints file only limits versions; it never adds packages. Two sets
# because pytest 9 needs Python 3.10 or newer: CI runs 3.9 and 3.12.
#
# To bump: install the new versions in a clean venv on both Pythons, run the
# full suite, then update the versions here in the same pull request.

# Both Pythons
pytest-xdist==3.8.0
execnet==2.1.2
PyYAML==6.0.3
packaging==26.3
Pygments==2.21.0

# Python 3.10 and newer
pytest==9.2.0; python_version >= "3.10"
pluggy==1.7.0; python_version >= "3.10"
iniconfig==2.3.1; python_version >= "3.10"
pyrage==1.4.0; python_version >= "3.10"

# Python 3.9
pytest==8.4.2; python_version < "3.10"
pluggy==1.6.0; python_version < "3.10"
iniconfig==2.1.0; python_version < "3.10"
pyrage==1.3.0; python_version < "3.10"
exceptiongroup==1.3.1; python_version < "3.10"
tomli==2.5.0; python_version < "3.10"
typing_extensions==4.16.0; python_version < "3.10"
